note: Pinned third-party build dependencies for Mayasaba. Vendored sources live under third_party/. Hashes are SHA-256 of the exact retrieved artifact. This manifest is the reproducible dependency record required by AGENTS.md section 12 and the technology matrix. No dependency is fetched at build time: the build is offline-restorable from the repository.

dependencies.name: nlohmann/json
dependencies.role: JSON parser/serializer. Not treated as canonical serialization; Mayasaba defines and tests its own canonical byte profile (contracts/CANONICAL.md).

dependencies.name: google/googletest
dependencies.role: Core unit/integration test framework (GoogleTest/GoogleMock candidate pinned).

build_only.name: Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK
build_only.restore: NuGet PackageReference from the app project; restored into the user NuGet cache. Not vendored because it is a build-time SDK component with its own servicing model.
build_only.role: WinUI 3 + Windows App SDK runtime for the Control Room UI (unpackaged, self-contained payload).

build_only.name: Microsoft.Windows.CppWinRT
build_only.restore: NuGet PackageReference; provides cppwinrt.exe code generation.

build_only.name: Microsoft.Windows.ImplementationLibrary
build_only.role: WIL resource wrappers (RAII handles) per technology baseline.

build_only.name: WiX Toolset
build_only.restore: Installed dotnet tool (already present on the build machine).
